summary: FirstService Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, furnishing a press release reporting its second-quarter 2026 earnings. The release details revenues of $1.45 billion, Adjusted EBITDA of $161.7 million, and Adjusted EPS of $1.75. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing is a routine earnings report for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
